newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Uzbek president to visit Prague in January.
newsitem.headline: Uzbek president to visit Prague in January.

text.p: Uzbekistan's President Islam Karimov is to make an official visit to the Czech Republic on January 14-16, a Czech government spokesman said on Tuesday.
Karimov was invited by Czech President Vaclav Havel, who is recuperating from cancer surgery performed on his lungs in early December.
Karimov is to meet Havel and Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus, and visit the Czech parliament and the engineering concern CKD Zlicin near Prague.
